notablePrerequisites: Elves you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
description:
Activate any number of Elves you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Each Elf tapped this way triggers, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Dionus, thus granting a fresh instance of the ability to each Elf you control.
Repeat.
